Team — forwarding Jamal's note. High priority. Initial triage (I pulled logs): the jobs hit long-tail queueing on our async shard pool and a concurrent GC spike on a small number of hosts running the rw-open-10b quantized runtime. Probable contributing factors:

- Momentary surge from VertexCorp's batch window overlapping with other large customers (peak at 03:00 UTC).
- Kernel fallback path triggered on older Ampere nodes causing CPU spin; these runs recovered but with long tail.

Proposal (short-term):
1) Offer a one-time invoice credit for impacted job window — recommend 10% of August usage for VertexCorp (negotiable).
2) Provide an explicit idempotency/run-token guidance so their retry controller doesn't double-charge tokens when they replay jobs. We'll supply idempotency headers and a recommended exponential backoff with jitter.
3) Prioritize their reruns for the next 48 hours and enable a temporary capacity pin on a newer GPU pool (us-west-2).

I'll draft the customer-facing note. Ben — can you include finance/discount approval? Marissa — please prepare the credit PDF and SLAs. Jonas — open INF-3497, add logs, and schedule on-call postmortem.

Mina

  * Temporary routing of your async jobs to a newer GPU pool in us-west-2 (no code changes).
  * An idempotency header field (Idempotency-Key) to be honored by Redwood for bulk/retry semantics — guidance doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/idempotency
  * A recommended retry/backoff pattern: initial retry at 30s, then exponential backoff with cap at 15m plus jitter; server will dedupe within a 48h window if Idempotency-Key present.
- Follow-up: postmortem ticket INF-3497 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3497) — we'll share RCA and mitigations within 5 business days.

Jamal — thanks for the quick reply and the specific asks. Confirmations below: 

- Deduplication semantics: Redwood will dedupe requests that present an Idempotency-Key per model/route pair for up to 48 hours after the first accepted request. A duplicate is defined as same Idempotency-Key + identical request body (byte-equal). We'll document edgecases in the idempotency guide (attached idempotency-guidelines-v1.md).
- Scope: the 48h dedupe window is a platform behavior for hosted deployments. For Dedicated customers we support equivalent semantics but the exact retention window can be configured by the customer; we'll include recommended default of 48h in a Dedicated runbook.
- Credit: we'll issue a one-time 10% credit for August usage tied to the affected job window. Marissa will generate the formal credit memo and we'll share on company letterhead.
- SOC2: last audit completed May 2026 — I'll include the audit month and SOC2 report pointer in the legal package.

Next steps (internal): Jonas to open INF-3497 and assign to infra/serving runtime; Marissa to prepare credit memo; Ben to coordinate with Vertex legal and confirm credit application method. We'll schedule a 30-minute postmortem on Wed 2026-09-02.
